verdict.rationale: Superpowers installs through each harness's own plugin mechanism and its porting guide says to never edit the user's files. A hands-on probe showed skills install selectively as self-contained markdown folders under ./.claude/skills/, which suggests removal is a simple folder deletion with no stray edits to instruction files. No evidence shows a list command, an uninstall command, or a verified clean removal, so this rests on inference from the install design. Missing for 10: a documented way to list installed skills, a documented uninstall/remove command, hands-on confirmation that removal leaves no orphaned files or lingering session-start/bootstrap injection, and per-harness removal guidance.
